+$/,'');const sections=[...md.matchAll(/^### (.+)$/gm)].map(m=>m[1]);const expected=['Summary','Context','Evidence','User story','Current behaviour','Requested behaviour','Configurable or global','Acceptance criteria','Out of scope','Related','Known gaps','Other information','Dev test brief'];const unavailable=['Customer','Customer Specific','CustomerFacing','Product','Feature (Inpatient)','Affected services'];const checks={descriptions_equal: norm(md)===norm(map.fields.Description),section_order_exact:JSON.stringify(sections)===JSON.stringify(expected),provenance_exact:map.provenance.Description==='COMPOSED - ticket body sourced from the verified facts, attributed reported claims, and dispositioned gaps in evidence-pack.md',unavailable_names_exact:JSON.stringify(map.unavailable_on_screen.map(x=>x.field))===JSON.stringify(unavailable),unavailable_all_carried:map.unavailable_on_screen.every(x=>x.carried_in_body===true)};if(Object.values(checks).some(v=>!v)){console.error(JSON.stringify(checks));process.exit(1)}console.log(JSON.stringify({...checks,fields_populated:Object.keys(map.fields).length,gaps_carried:(md.match(/^- \[ \] GAP-/gm)||[]).length,timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}));
